subject: correction: assistant.spec 'Ask Naadi' failures were my local DB (assistant flag left off); real remaining issue: assistant.spec:345 vs seg12b's 29e7bad
body:
Retraction of 110612/115141: my local app_config.feature_flags had assistant.enabled=false (left by an interrupted admin config edit+revert e2e). With the flag restored, assistant.spec passes 16/18 on WebKit iPad + Chromium at f2af55c. Sorry for the noise, seg14.
Real issue (seg12b + seg14): assistant.spec.ts:345 'an answer renders as plain text while the markdown renderer cannot load' fails 3/3 on WebKit iPad portrait (Chromium timing-dependent) since 29e7bad: the test page.route()s every /assets/*.js after openFirstSection to hold the markdown chunks, and SectionInk's ink engine is now a lazy chunk loaded after paint, so it is held too and [data-ink-idle] never attaches (passes at 29e7bad~1). Suggest the test waits for [data-ink-idle] before it starts holding, or holds only the markdown/Shiki/KaTeX chunks.
